name: IPinfo (API and web pages)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8): 'IPinfo is an established company: tier trusted.' (P036 rationale); 'trusted - bgp.he.net (Hurricane Electric), IPinfo' (P057 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Commercial IP geolocation and ASN data (Lite: country and ASN): usually reliable; geolocation is an estimate.

ipinfo.description: IPinfo token (Lite API: country and ASN; Authorization: Bearer header only)
ipinfo.plan_hint: business = a company/team IPinfo account whose plan and terms URL legal records (P036 cond 2; IPinfo Lite is CC BY-SA 4.0 with commercial use allowed, attribution required)

api.title: IPinfo API (Lite /lite/{ip}, core /{ip}/json)

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account; legal records the plan and terms URL (IPinfo Lite is CC BY-SA 4.0 with commercial use allowed, verified 2026-11-26) before it runs under the corporate profile.

api.notes: Research C0084 terms 'IPinfo terms; Lite data CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution)'. Token only in 'Authorization: Bearer', never ?token= (the cache stores URLs); keyless calls are disabled (429 'Rate limit hit' from shared egress); 403 'Unknown token' = NEEDS_KEY (P036 cond 1, cond 4). Attribution to IPinfo (CC BY-SA 4.0) in reports, `v3lum info` and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; case data only, never bundled (P036 cond 5). The Lite API documentation states 'The API has no daily or monthly limit and provides unlimited access.' (checked 2026-11-26): no quota block. Used by ipinfo.

web_pages.title: IPinfo IP and ASN pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

web_pages.notes: Research C0133 terms 'Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)' / 'site terms'. Manual links ipinfo.io/{ip} and ipinfo.io/AS{asn} (P036 cond 3, P057 cond 8). ipinfo.io answers scripts with API JSON, so its terms page renders only in a browser. Used by pivots_ip_network.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G02-1 and p2-G14-1 (P036, P057). Key 'ipinfo' is also in the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS table (alias IPINFO_TOKEN); config.key_registry() merges the aliases.
